branches.text: Candidate indication review topic: established current antipsychotic association with present parkinsonism is recorded in this context; review dose, switch, symptomatic, continuation, amantadine and prophylaxis topics with the clinician. This experimental distribution does not prescribe treatment Distribution: {ParkinsonismIndicationReview}.

Candidate indication review topic: assess differential and association with the clinician, including Parkinson disease, another neurological disorder, catatonia, negative symptoms, depressive slowing, exposure history, onset timing and longitudinal course in this context Distribution: {ParkinsonismIndicationReview}.

Candidate indication review topic: no current treatment rule in this absent context; retain ongoing clinician review. This is not a negative clinical finding Distribution: {ParkinsonismIndicationReview}.

Candidate regimen review topic: review dose reduction and switch feasibility with the clinician when both are recorded feasible without psychotic-worsening concern in this context. This does not prescribe a dose change Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.
Candidate regimen review topic: review dose reduction feasibility with the clinician in this context. This does not prescribe a dose change Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.
Candidate regimen review topic: review switch feasibility with the clinician in this context. This does not prescribe a switch Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.
Candidate regimen review topic: review dose and switch constraints with the clinician in this context Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.

Candidate regimen review topic: prioritize psychosis tradeoff review with careful monitoring for symptom recurrence when psychotic-worsening concern is recorded in this context Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.
Candidate regimen review topic: establish indication and differential first with the clinician before regimen review in this context Distribution: {ParkinsonismAntipsychoticRegimenReview}.

Candidate anticholinergic safety review topic: enhanced individualized review with the clinician per current labeling when a safety, older-age or combined burden concern is recorded in this context Distribution: {AnticholinergicSafetyReview}.
Candidate anticholinergic safety review topic: routine individualized review with the clinician in this context Distribution: {AnticholinergicSafetyReview}.

Candidate symptomatic medication review topic: review the tardive-dyskinesia differential with the clinician, since anticholinergic treatment can worsen tardive dyskinesia in this context. This does not prescribe a symptomatic medication Distribution: {SymptomaticMedicationReview}.

Candidate symptomatic medication review topic: discuss anticholinergic option tradeoffs and patient concerns with the clinician in this context. This does not prescribe a symptomatic medication Distribution: {SymptomaticMedicationReview}.

Candidate symptomatic medication review topic: discuss the anticholinergic option with the clinician when no tardive-differential or preference concern is recorded in this context. This does not prescribe a symptomatic medication Distribution: {SymptomaticMedicationReview}.

Candidate symptomatic medication review topic: establish indication and differential first with the clinician before symptomatic discussion in this context Distribution: {SymptomaticMedicationReview}.

Candidate continuation review topic: review the lowest effective dose and shortest necessary duration with the clinician when current anticholinergic use with present parkinsonism is recorded in this context. This does not prescribe continuation Distribution: {ParkinsonismAnticholinergicContinuationReview}.

Candidate continuation review topic: reassess need and differential with the clinician, since reduction or withdrawal after weeks to months can occur without recurrence in this context Distribution: {ParkinsonismAnticholinergicContinuationReview}.

Candidate continuation review topic: no current continuation rule in this context; retain ongoing clinician review. This is not a negative clinical finding Distribution: {ParkinsonismAnticholinergicContinuationReview}.
Candidate amantadine review topic: discuss the amantadine alternative and its safety profile with the clinician in this context. This does not prescribe amantadine Distribution: {AmantadineReview}.

Candidate amantadine review topic: review specific renal, hallucination, suicidal-thought or seizure safety concerns with the clinician per current labeling in this context Distribution: {AmantadineReview}.
Candidate amantadine review topic: establish indication and differential first with the clinician before amantadine review in this context Distribution: {AmantadineReview}.

Candidate prophylaxis review topic: individualized exceptional-risk review with the clinician when present parkinsonism with significant prior parkinsonism is recorded in this context; there is no routine prophylaxis rule Distribution: {ProphylaxisReview}.
Candidate prophylaxis review topic: no routine prophylaxis rule in this context; retain ongoing clinician review. This is not a negative clinical finding Distribution: {ProphylaxisReview}.

Candidate prophylaxis review topic: address the current assessment with the clinician when present parkinsonism without significant prior parkinsonism is recorded in this context Distribution: {ProphylaxisReview}.

disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
An absent case is not_applicable and claims no posterior; it is never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.
Unresolved, unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting required context pauses; absent is never coerced from not assessed and no missing finding maps to No.

SAS supports measurement; its total or mean alone never establishes etiology and no SAS score threshold determines intervention; the up-to-0.3 convention and the 0.7 screening proposal are review candidates only and no mild/moderate/severe bands are created.
Urgent NMS-triage banner comes from saved structured urgent inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage.
No dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are collected or accepted; Table 10 prescribing details are background only and not copied as activation metadata.
rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
urgent_banner: Parallel urgent banner from saved structured NMS-triage inputs (fever, altered consciousness, autonomic instability or severe generalized rigidity), shown independently of estimation latency; arrange immediate clinician NMS evaluation per local protocol rather than attributing to uncomplicated parkinsonism. This is not a computed risk percentage.
